claims.observation: Published synthetic N2 spectrum, not an experimental gas measurement: float64 measurements and nu_axis each (1,200), 2280 to 2330 cm^-1. Metadata gives 10 bar, 1 cm^-1 pump linewidth, 0.5 cm^-1 slit width and noise level 0.02. Ground-truth temperature is int64, despite README float64 claim.

Selected BenchmarkRunner L1/L2/L3 visible paths all include data/. Actual LocalRunner.start copied the complete acquired data directory, including ground_truth.npz, in three retained fixtures. Exec was intercepted: no install or runner command executed. L2 adds approach, which explicitly states true 2400 K; L3 adds design. These levels are not demonstrated hidden-reference evaluations.

Docker source mounts the entire task directory read-only at /workspace_src, in addition to seeding selected paths. Read-only does not hide references. No Docker container was launched and no OS isolation claim is made.

Pinned forward_operator uses 30 rotational states, two vibrational levels and Q/O/S branches with a temperature-dependent relaxation matrix. It combines resonant and nonresonant amplitudes, applies the implemented pump/slit operations, locally averages a 0.05 cm^-1 fine grid and max-normalizes. Four deterministic evaluations reproduce the clean spectrum within 1.34e-11; no inverse solve was run.

In this implementation both susceptibility terms scale linearly with x_mol; final max normalization cancels that amplitude factor. At T=2400 K, x_mol=0.79 and 0.2 produce normalized curves differing by at most 2.23e-16. This is an implementation diagnostic, not a general physical identifiability claim.

Retained reference output contains a (1,200) fitted spectrum and temperature 2391.5641794510043 K. Replaying task compute_metrics against the measured spectrum gives NCC 0.998360879739001, NRMSE 0.01823990675524816 and 8.435820548995707 K error versus 2400 K. No new fitting, LLM attempt or success-rate claim.

Source run_inversion fits temperature, mole fraction, spectral shift and slit width using bounded scipy least_squares(method=trf,max_nfev=100). Bounds are [300,3500] K, [0.1,1], [-5,5] cm^-1 and [0.01,5] cm^-1. L2 prose calls it LM, but executable source chooses trf. We did not execute the optimizer.

Scorer._compute_quality_metrics calls reference_scoring.score_reconstruction for a filesystem workspace. It expects output/reconstruction.npy and compares shape-selected references. For (1,200), ground_truth.npz:spectrum is selected, giving saved-fit NRMSE 0.002403 rather than the task-native measured-spectrum 0.018240. No temperature-error field is emitted.

A separate task_scoring CARS adapter expects reconstruction.npz with y_pred and temperature_pred, compares to measured spectrum and checks absolute temperature error. Scorer defines _score_task_aware but the active quality-metric method does not call it. Same saved curve plus a constructed 300 K temperature retains native NCC yet yields 2100 K error.

Generic preprocessing squeezes only ndim>2. Flattened (200,) fitted output fails to match either multi-array NPZ; (1,200) works. A (1,) temperature array selects temperature by shape, produces infinite range-normalized NRMSE and no Kelvin-error metric. Preserve the batch axis for the spectral reconstruction contract.

Pinned Git tree and pinned assets_manifest contain no CARS metrics.json or evaluation/tests files. Therefore generic saved-output replay has no pass/fail and native _check_pass yields None without thresholds. A live HF directory listing timed out, so absence across all external stores is not established. Docker fallback inspects only ground_truth.npy, while acquired CARS reference is NPZ; no Docker path was executed.

Raw no-op gives generic NCC 0.998346 and NRMSE 0.018418. Clean-reference oracle gives zero error; it is a diagnostic that must not be presented as solver evidence. All results are stored with exact array shapes and origin.
